summary: Iter-65 FRONTEND: exercised the IPV/family-violence safety gate end-to-end across the new Foundation Statement + Co-Parenting Agreement flow. Data set up via /app/backend/tests/_iter65_ui_setup.py (mirrors test_iter65_safety_gate.py). Verified: (A) Parent Foundation editor /foundation?case={rid} — [foundation-safety-screen] renders the three questions with Yes/No pills [foundation-safety-{fear|threats|control}-{yes|no}]; [foundation-case-share-btn] is initially disabled; clicking Yes on 'fear' surfaces [foundation-safety-route] whose body contains the National Domestic Violence Hotline number 1-800-799-7233; with the two other questions answered No, the share button stays disabled and [foundation-case-share-block] text contains 'paused' ('Sharing is paused because of your safety answers…'); flipping the Yes back to No hides the route; button remains disabled while the statement is still Draft (as expected — needs complete=True AND safety complete AND !flagged); after filling required fields + save, status becomes Complete. Overflow: at 1920x800 body 1920==1920 and section 652==652; at 390x844 body 390==390 and section 306==306 — no horizontal overflow. (B) Parent on /joint/{rid} — [share-foundation-btn] visible; clicking POSTs /api/joint/reports/{rid}/foundation/share which returns 409 (safety-flagged, verified from network); the block shows [share-foundation-safety-route] with text 'Safety pathway. Your answers indicate a safety concern…' and NO error toast is displayed. (C) Professional /joint/{rid_high_risk} — with Legal Lens risk_screening.threats.level 'High Risk' saved, [submit-include-agreement-label] carries class 'border-red-300' (red border) and [submit-agreement-safety-warning] is present ('Safety Override applies. Professional risk screening recorded moderate-to-high or high risk indicators.'); ticking [submit-include-agreement] fires a window.confirm ('Safety indicators exist for these parents. The attached agreement will be the Parallel Parenting variant…'); accepting shows [submit-agreement-picked] with 'SA-26-AGR-W4XJGU · 2026-09-26'; ticking [submit-attest] and clicking [submit-to-court-btn] triggers a second confirm (lock warning), then POST /api/joint/reports/{rid}/submit-to-court returns 200. (D) Judge /court/case/{refId} — [court-agreement-card] class includes 'border-[#e0b04a] bg-[#fff7df]' (gold-toned); [court-agreement-safety-override] text starts with 'Safety Override — Parallel Parenting Structure' followed by 'Family-violence or safety indicators were identified. This agreement therefore follows a Parallel Parent…'; [court-agreement-pdf] href points to /api/court-dashboard/packets/{pid}/agreement.pdf and downloads a 67,976-byte application/pdf whose extracted text contains both 'Parallel Parenting' and 'Safety Override'. Overflow on the judge card: 1920x800 body 1920==1920 card 922==922; 390x844 body 390==390 card 288==288 — no horizontal overflow.
critical_code_review_comments: FoundationEditor.jsx L88: the [foundation-case-share-btn] disabled logic depends on `meta?.complete` (only known after save). Consequence — a user who answers Yes on any question BEFORE saving would already see the paused-block copy, but the block's default 'requested' copy still shows 'Answer the safety questions, save, then share it into the case.' until you toggle to Yes. Consider moving safety-flagged copy above the save gate so the ordering is unambiguous.

ShareFoundation.jsx L14: 409 is silently swallowed and only surfaced as the inline notice (no toast). Correct product-wise, but a 400 (unanswered safety) would toast the raw formatApiError. Consider handling both 400 and 409 with tailored inline copy so a parent who has not filled the safety screen doesn't see a raw 'safety questions not answered' toast.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (A parent-editor safety gate, B parent joint-page share->409 inline notice, C pro submit-with-agreement + confirm + 200, D judge gold card + safety-override banner + agreement PDF containing 'Parallel Parenting' + 'Safety Override'; overflow at 1920x800 and 390x844 both clean on editor safety section and judge card)
